journey.name: ordinary wallet during Paykit outage
journey.description: Use disposable test-network wallets with synthetic funds and compatible service fault controls. Delay public endpoint publication, endpoint cleanup and an unrelated retained Paykit proof while leaving wallet-node and VSS services available. Never use live funds. iOS requires public sharing for the receive case, and a retained authenticated identity with Paykit UI disabled for the startup case. Android must have a retained proof for the unrelated request. These controls are not currently wired into the full app journey; native component coverage must not be reported as this execution. Android already prepares receive data independently; iOS already presents ordinary Lightning pending results independently. Both platforms must keep genuine payment-request proof requirements.

actions.action: Edit an ordinary receive amount and note, then show its QR while public endpoint publication is delayed; verify the QR contains the current amount and note without waiting for Pubky
Close and reopen receive, restore Pubky access and verify current public endpoints reconcile without restoring a superseded invoice or a signed-out identity
With pending order or swap recovery and disabled Paykit UI, start the wallet while endpoint cleanup is delayed; verify unrelated recovery watchers start
Hold unrelated proof maintenance, send a controlled ordinary Lightning invoice that fails and verify its error appears without waiting for Paykit; verify no automatic second payment is created
Repeat with a controlled pending Lightning result and verify the original payment hash is tracked and shown as pending; do not submit another payment
Release the service faults, restart and verify retained Paykit work reconciles; a real Paykit request must still require authorization and proof bookkeeping
